assumptions.heuristic: Unmodified existing heuristic with public species/set priors; no benchmark tuning.
assumptions.greedy: Neutral unknown ability/item; calculator neutral nature, zero EVs and 31 IVs for unobserved stats. These are scoring hypotheses, not revealed facts. Accuracy-weighted mean damage; first legal action breaks ties.
assumptions.intervals: Wilson 95% Bernoulli win probability; ties are non-wins. Paired games are dependent; interval is descriptive, not a paired-inference claim.
assumptions.legality: All agents exclude voluntary switches when the addressed raw request signals maybeTrapped; no opponent ability inspection. Engine rejection is never retried or erased.
assumptions.timing: Nondeterministic timings join deterministic records by game_id.
